CustomField.description: Required on insert even for gifts in Paid status. For outright gifts, set equal to `TransactionDate`. For pledge payments, match the parent `GiftCommitmentSchedule` installment row.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The date this gift was expected. For a one-time gift you're recording now, set the same date as Transaction Date. For a pledge or recurring payment, this matches the installment's scheduled due date.
